name: KAM
spec: ECMA-48 §7.2.11; refused: a program could lock the keyboard of the only terminal on the console (libtsm#57)

name: SRM
spec: ECMA-48 §7.2.15; reset, what the terminal sends the program is also shown (local echo)

name: LNM
spec: ctlseqs; VT510; kept though ECMA-48's 5th edition withdraws it (ADR-1000)

name: DECCKM
spec: ctlseqs; VT510

name: DECANM
spec: ctlseqs; VT510; VT52 is declined for now (vtium/vtium#65), so DECRQM reports ANSI mode as permanent

name: DECCOLM
spec: ctlseqs; VT510; refused: the console's size comes from the display and the font (libtsm#57)

name: DECSCLM
spec: ctlseqs; VT510; a console has no smooth scroll

name: DECSCNM
spec: ctlseqs; VT510

name: DECOM
spec: ctlseqs; VT510; the cursor goes home as it is set or reset (VT100 User Guide)

name: DECAWM
spec: ctlseqs; VT510

name: DECARM
spec: ctlseqs; VT510; the host repeats a held key, and stops while it is reset

name: X10MOUSE
spec: ctlseqs, X10 mouse; DECSTR resets it, where xterm resets it on RIS only (libtsm#76)

name: CURBLINK
default: set by the host's cursor blink
spec: ctlseqs, AT&T 610 cursor blink; held in a DECSCUSR style, while the default style blinks as the host's setting says

name: DECPFF
spec: ctlseqs; VT510; a console has no printer

name: DECPEX
spec: ctlseqs; VT510; a console has no printer

name: DECTCEM
spec: ctlseqs; VT510

name: DECNRCM
spec: ctlseqs; VT510; refused: national replacement sets are obsolete next to UTF-8 (libtsm#57)

name: ALTBUF
spec: ctlseqs, the alternate screen, neither cleared nor the cursor saved

name: VT200MOUSE
spec: ctlseqs, normal tracking; DECSTR resets it, where xterm resets it on RIS only (libtsm#76)

name: HILITEMOUSE
spec: ctlseqs; refused: the terminal waits on the program's XTHIMOUSE answer before it can show a selection (ADR-1000)

name: BTNMOUSE
spec: ctlseqs, button-event tracking; DECSTR resets it, where xterm resets it on RIS only (libtsm#76)

name: ANYMOUSE
spec: ctlseqs, any-event tracking; DECSTR resets it, where xterm resets it on RIS only (libtsm#76)

name: FOCUS
spec: ctlseqs, FocusIn and FocusOut; DECSTR resets it, where xterm resets it on RIS only (libtsm#76)

name: SGRMOUSE
spec: ctlseqs, SGR encoding, whatever order the modes were set in; DECSTR resets it, where xterm resets it on RIS only (libtsm#76)

name: PIXMOUSE
spec: ctlseqs, SGR-Pixels encoding, pixels counted from 1; DECSTR resets it, where xterm resets it on RIS only (libtsm#76)

name: ALTBUF1047
spec: ctlseqs, the alternate screen, cleared as it is left

name: SAVECUR
spec: ctlseqs, "Save cursor as in DECSC": set saves, reset restores as DECRC does, and nothing stays set

name: ALTBUF1049
spec: ctlseqs, the cursor saved as in DECSC and the alternate screen cleared as it is entered; leaving restores the cursor and the pen as DECRC does (libtsm#20)

name: BRPASTE
spec: ctlseqs, bracketed paste; a paste never carries its own end marker (ADR-1000)

name: SYNC
spec: contour synchronized-output; offered while the host presents by it

name: GRAPHEME
default: set by the host's width method
spec: contour unicode-core; RIS and DECSTR return it to the configured method

name: SCHEMEREPORT
spec: contour color-palette-update-notifications; CSI ? 997 ; Ps n when the default background turns dark or light by its luma (ITU-R BT.601), as CSI ? 996 n answers

name: VISREPORT
spec: foot(7), rockorager's visibility reports; CSI ? 999 ; Ps n as it is set and on each change, a VT switch or a blank

name: RESIZEREPORT
spec: rockorager's in-band resize notifications; CSI 48 ; rows ; cols ; height ; width t as it is set and after each resize, the text area in pixels 0 while the cell size is unknown
